- **Institution:** [New College of Florida](https://www.ncf.edu)

This project was built for Data Science using R, tidyverse, and Quarto, examining Drake's historical Billboard longevity and global streaming dominance.

## Data Sources

The data for this project was gathered from three primary sources: historical Billboard Hot 100 weekly archives (2009–2021) curated by [TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/master/data/2021/2021-09-14) and [Billboard.com](https://www.billboard.com/artist/drake/chart-history/) covering 2,569 weekly charted observations; global Spotify catalog telemetry and streaming metrics compiled by the [kworb.net Spotify Artist Tracker](https://kworb.net/spotify/artist/3TVXtAsR1Inumwj472S9r4_songs.html) across 547 songs; and cross-platform digital distribution data from [Songstats](https://songstats.com/track/ul9j1yr4/drake).
